# UiFormErrorSummary

Lists every validation error of a form, deep fields included, with links that focus the field.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | forms |
| Import | `import { UiFormErrorSummary } from '@your-scope/ui/forms'` |
| Direct import | `import UiFormErrorSummary from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiFormErrorSummary'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/forms/UiFormErrorSummary.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/forms/UiFormErrorSummary.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `of` | `FormStore<any>` |  | Formisch store. Defaults to the store of the surrounding UiForm. |
| `title` | `string` |  | Heading text. Defaults to the translated "There is a problem". |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `2` |  |
| `reveal` | `'submitted' \| 'always'` | `'submitted'` | When the summary appears. `submitted` (default): after a submission attempt, like the fields bound with `useUiFormField()`, because Formisch validates every field as soon as one of them is left. `always`: whenever the store holds an error. |
| `errors` | `'first' \| 'all'` | `'first'` | Messages listed per field: `first` (default, matching what `useUiFormField()` shows at the field) or `all`. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `entry` | `props: { entry: UiFormErrorEntry; focus: () => void }` | One entry (label, message and link by default). |

## Attributes

The root `<div>`.

## Keyboard

- Each entry is a link; activating it focuses the field.

## Accessibility

- Uses `getDeepErrorEntries`, so nested and array fields are included.
- A labelled group; it becomes `role="alert"` only for form-level errors, which no field would announce.
- Entry text is "<field label>: <message>", taken from the field's real label or legend.

## Styling

- `.vui-alert.vui-error-summary`, `.vui-error-summary__list`
